summary.text: Kevin Wolsky is the Republican candidate for the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 29, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 9, 2026 Republican primary.
According to Ballotpedia, he is a farmer and small business owner from Carrington who previously served on the Carrington Public School District board.

paragraphs.text: Wolsky graduated from Carrington High School and earned a bachelor's degree from North Dakota State University in 2001, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a third-generation farmer who farms more than 5,000 acres with his son and owns or partners in several businesses in agriculture, food service and bottled water distribution.
The survey response says he and his wife, Jennifer, have nine children, including one through adoption, and have been foster parents for nearly seven years.

Wolsky's survey response says he served on the Carrington High School Board for 12 years, sat on the North Dakota State Advisory Board, and is vice chairman of the North Dakota Dry Pea and Lentil Council.
It also says he received a National Young Farmer award in 2016.
The response says he is running to address concerns including property taxes and the cost of doing business in rural North Dakota, and to make sure rural producers get what it calls a fair shake.
